scenarios.name: Continuous speech crosses a language replay boundary
scenarios.given: Automatic recording has switched language and is replaying earlier speech while original finalized text remains visible
scenarios.when: one growing utterance starts before the switch cut and continues beyond it, then finalizes or is replayed by Undo
scenarios.then: the continuing partial is visible, originals survive until replacement finals exist, the crossing final appears once, later language checks resume and Stop and Undo remain usable without cloud inference

manual.reason: Injected recorder/model results establish session behavior; physical SpeechAnalyzer timing and bilingual audio require separate acceptance
steps: Record continuously across a spoken-language change on a physical iPhone; inspect partial/final progress, Stop and Undo.

scenarios.name: Language preparation cannot switch inactive recording
scenarios.given: an Automatic recording is waiting for on-device language model preparation
scenarios.when: the app becomes inactive before preparation returns and then becomes active again
scenarios.then: the inactive completion cannot start detection or change the recording language, its text and recording identity survive, foreground can retry and Stop remains usable; continued background audio stays bounded and foreground detection uses recent retained speech after a long suspension

scenarios.name: Recover a language replay that makes no progress during sustained audio activity
scenarios.given: a live Automatic language switch is replaying old audio without advancing recognized results
scenarios.when: thirty seconds of accepted audio activity accumulate without progress or the same-locale restart fails
scenarios.then: one restart without replay fences the superseded results, preserves uncovered finalized text and saved-audio choice, keeps capture active, explains possible missing speech and allows later language checks; silence never triggers recovery and advancing results reset its activity budget; Stop cancels a held recovery without a late replacement or status

manual.reason: Injected result scheduling proves session recovery and privacy policy, not physical native-recognizer accuracy or every platform timing interleaving
steps: On physical iPhone/iPad, verify a long language switch continues microphone capture, truthful recovery notice, no duplicate old finals, later checks, Stop and Undo; retain saved audio only with opt-in.

scenarios.name: Undo owns its native replacement across scene and conversation changes
scenarios.given: a user taps Undo for a switched language while capture is active
scenarios.when: context or native preparation is held across inactivity, or native replacement commits before a later context await and Stop/New follows
scenarios.then: uncommitted Undo is cancelled without a late native switch, pin, restored text or error in another conversation; committed native locale and language metadata change together, foreground permits an explicit retry and Stop remains authoritative; Stop cancels uncommitted Undo before finalization so an explicit stopping-time Undo can be queued and applied after drain
